name: uberasm-reload-layer
title: Reload Layer 3 During Submap Transitions
description:
This UberASM acts as a workaround for a problem with the submap transitions ("red path" transitions) which do not load the submap's layer 3 tilemap, causing it to carry over from the previous map. This UberASM allows you to reload the tilemaps at the cost of inserting all the maps' tilemaps uncompressed in ROM (as well as having them inserted compressed with Lunar Magic), which takes a bit of ROM space. Also, the level name will be erased until Mario lands on a new level tile (a similar effect may also happen for other custom codes you use that write to layer 3).
To make the transition smoother, you can pair this with the Different Submap Switching Transition patch (so it doesn't show the layer 3 suddenly changing).
For instructions on how to use it, check out the asm file.
Originally made for the OWDC2021 contest.
